claims: Turn off your phone before attempting to clean the headphone jack.
Use a wooden toothpick or a soft, dry interdental brush to gently scoop out the lint.
Do not use metal objects like needles or pins, as they can damage the internal contacts.
Avoid inserting compressed air into the jack, as it can push debris deeper inside.

claims.text: Switch the phone off and use a light to spot lint in the port.
Gently loosen the lint with a wooden or plastic toothpick while avoiding metal tools.
